title: Heavy/Signature Constructs: Turret, Mech Arm, Jet/Drill, Fist Swarm
description:
Purpose: High-cost, high-impact constructs gated by Willpower Focus threshold with telegraphed charge-up, two-hand stabilization, cooldowns, and massive payoffs. Ideal for boss and defense phases.

Controls:
- Select Heavy category via wheel; Right Trigger to begin charge; hold to full, release to deploy. Left Grip stabilizes two-handed alignment; Right Grip can adjust orientation during preview.

Params (params_json):
- willpower_focus_required (float, default 0.6)
- cooldown_s (float, default 20.0)
- per_construct_costs: turret=8, mech_arm=10, jet_drill=12, fist_swarm=10 (defaults)

Behaviour per form:
1) Turret (construct_turret): spawns autonomous emitter with target prioritization; drains ring energy per second while alive; despawns on low energy or after duration.
2) Mech Arm (construct_mech_arm): performs sweeping punch/ground pound sequence toward targeted zone; emits shockwave VFX; brief player slow to sell weight.
3) Energy Jet/Drill (construct_energy_jet_drill): sustained forward cone with armor break multiplier; ideal for boss plates; rooted to world at spawn for stability.
4) Fist Swarm (construct_fist_swarm): spawns orbiting fists that dash to marked targets in bursts.

Components:
- Reads: Willpower Focus from ring resource system (promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge), CTransform, target list.
- Writes: construct spawns, cooldown trackers, resource drain events, VFX/Haptics.

Comfort/safety:
- Two-hand stabilization reduces jitter during charge; no camera roll; big motions are VFX/world anchored.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_heavy_construct_cooldown (cooldowns visible on HUD), test_boss_phase_break_armor (Jet/Drill breaks armor during window).

Integration:
- Registers under Heavy category in promoted.ring_construct_core.
- Uses assets: construct_turret, construct_mech_arm, construct_energy_jet_drill, construct_fist_swarm.

Scenes:
- large_oa_defense_battlefield, open_orbital_battlefield.

Suggested file split: heavy_constructs_register.cpp, heavy_turret.cpp, heavy_mech_arm.cpp, heavy_jet_drill.cpp, heavy_fist_swarm.cpp.
